---
name: Suggest a test or an extension
about: An idea for another test, a setting to cover, a measure to report, a fault in a test, or a request to use this repository for something else
title: "Suggestion: "
labels: suggestion
---

The benchmark is not open to changes; ideas come in here and we decide what goes into a later version. The guide says what helps: https://github.com/Bicameral-AI/claude-code-mode-benchmark/blob/main/BENCHMARK_GUIDE.md#suggesting-a-test-or-an-extension

**What do you want measured, and why do the current six tests not show it?**

**For a new test: what would Claude be asked, what is the right answer, and how could a script check it?**

**What do you expect it to show, with Code Mode off and with it on?**

**If you are asking to use this repository to test something else** (another feature, another tool, a comparison of models): what would you test, which parts of the repository would you use, and where would the results go?

**Anything you have already seen that prompted this** (a result from your own run, a transcript, a release note)
